ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
SortByColumns(
    Filter(
        colPHR_RowCells_Active,
        Text(SubsystemCode) = Text(ThisItem.SubsystemCode)
    ),
    "LocalColIndex",
    SortOrder.Ascending
)

"" & "" & Concat( SortByColumns( colPHR_HeaderL4_Active, "LocalColIndex", SortOrder.Ascending ), "" ) & "" & "" & Concat( SortByColumns(colPHR_HeaderL1_Active,"StartCol",SortOrder.Ascending), "" ) & "" & "" & Concat( SortByColumns(colPHR_HeaderL2_Active,"StartCol",SortOrder.Ascending), "" ) & "" & "" & Concat( SortByColumns(colPHR_HeaderL3_Active,"StartCol",SortOrder.Ascending), "" ) & "" & "" & Concat( SortByColumns(colPHR_HeaderL4_Active,"LocalColIndex",SortOrder.Ascending), "" ) & "" & "
" & L1Label & "
" & If( Len(L2Label) > 32, Left(L2Label, 29) & "...", L2Label ) & "
" & If( Len(L3Label) > 34, Left(L3Label, 31) & "...", L3Label ) & "
" & Switch( Upper(MetricLabel), "TOTAL", "T", "DONE", "D", "REMAINING", "R", "REM.", "R", Left(MetricLabel, 3) ) & "
"

If(
    Upper(Text(ThisItem.MetricLabel)) in ["REM.", "REMAINING"],
    If(
        Value(ThisItem.CellValue) = 0,
        RGBA(236,253,245,1),
        If(
            Value(ThisItem.CellValue) <= 5,
            RGBA(254,249,195,0.72),
            RGBA(254,226,226,0.72)
        )
    ),
    Color.Transparent
)

If(
    Upper(Text(ThisItem.MetricLabel)) in ["REM.", "REMAINING"] && Value(ThisItem.CellValue) > 5,
    RGBA(185,28,28,1),
    RGBA(15,23,42,1)
)
